title: phUSD mint authority is load-bearing for solvency: revocation, pause, or supply cap on IFlax bricks claim/stake/withdraw, stranding both phUSD principal and reward tokens
rootCause: `_claimRewards` calls `phUSD.mint(user, pendingPhUSDAmount)` unconditionally whenever `pendingPhUSDAmount > 0`. No try/catch, no fallback. If `phUSD.mint` reverts (revokeAllMintPrivileges, phUSD pause, supply cap, blacklist), then `_claimRewards` reverts, which bricks `claim`/`stake`/`withdraw` for any user with a pre-existing position. Only `pauseWithdraw` remains usable (and forfeits rewards per DEDUP-011).
impactSummary: Single external action on the phUSD sibling can globally brick this staking contract. Stakers with non-zero pending phUSD are locked out of withdraw/claim; pending rewardToken is stranded alongside. Recovery requires Pauser cooperation and DEDUP-011-style reward forfeiture.
preservedDetails: ECON-006 carries the full trust-boundary analysis tying profile §10 assumption #1 to the on-chain DoS, and lists the variants (per-block mint cap, blacklist, governance revocation).
remediation: Wrap `phUSD.mint` in try/catch; on failure, accrue to an `unpaidPhUSDDebt` mapping and continue. Provide a `claimUnpaidPhUSD()` settlement path. Separately, allow withdraw in a 'principal-only' mode that skips `_claimRewards`.
dedupNotes: Single source. Cross-references DEDUP-011 (downstream forfeiture path users are forced into when this triggers).
